issue_context.title: mppStoreLastFailTime is not thread-safety
issue_context.body: ## Bug Report Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks! ### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required) ### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required) ### 3. What did you see instead (Required) ### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required) master

review_comments: I'm not sure, but in the previous code it is a map pointer copy so that `sessionStates.MPPStoreLastFailTime` and `s.MPPStoreLastFailTime` are sharing the same data and will affect each other. In the new code here is a key copy. Will this notably affect performance?

I think it's fine.
`EncodeSessionStates` is called only when migrating sessions. What's more, it will marshal `MPPStoreLastFailTime`, which may cost more time than copying. I think the size of `MPPStoreLastFailTime` won't be very big, so it's fine.
Better to add a comment for its key and value type, otherwise developers must infer its type by carefully reading the code.
